gate: 18+ symbolic philosophy track. No explicit visuals, no intimate acts, no alcohol or transgression on screen. Flower and water stand in for tattvas; verses appear as text; screen fades before anything intimate. Off by default.

quests.name: Five Elements Contemplation
quests.brief: Complete 1 Forest Dhyana; offer flower+water in mind. Opens vama_dakshina_equal tab.

quests.name: Kula-Kundalini Axis
quests.brief: Stand at the dwaja line (sanctum door) after Tattva. Opens kula_kundalini tab.

quests.name: Vira Resolve
quests.brief: Defeat 1 bandit with steady mind (after Kula). Opens kamya_defense_only tab.

requires: Rank 3 + gate ON + tantri permission (3 seva completions via rituals idx>=3)
